name: Permanent residence permit (zezwolenie na pobyt stały)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires holding a valid, currently unexpired Pole's Card and an intention to settle permanently in Poland.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a Pole's Card first (see pl_karta_polaka).

outcome_override.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum prior residence period in Poland required at all

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of continuous, legal residence in Poland directly before the application, including time on a temporary residence permit for other circumstances.
requirements.fix_path: Continue accruing continuous legal residence; breaks under 6 months at a time (10 months total) are tolerated.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a stable, regular source of income sufficient to cover the applicant and any dependants.
requirements.fix_path: Document stable employment, business, or other regular income.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires valid health insurance (NFZ or private) covering costs in Poland.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm NFZ coverage through employment or purchase qualifying private insurance.

requirement_groups.name: Married to a Polish citizen, 3 years married + 2 years residence

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least 3 years of marriage to a Polish citizen before the application, and at least 2 years of continuous residence in Poland directly before the application on a marriage-linked temporary permit.
requirements.fix_path: Continue the marriage and residence until both thresholds are met.

outcome_override.duration_length: unlimited (residence card itself valid 10 years, renewed as a card only, not a fresh permit)

requirement_groups.name: Refugee status, subsidiary protection, or humanitarian stay, 5 years

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of continuous residence in Poland directly connected to refugee status, subsidiary protection, or a humanitarian-grounds stay.

outcome_override.duration_length: unlimited (residence card itself valid 10 years, renewed as a card only, not a fresh permit)

evidence_required.document: Proof of continuous residence for the applicable period (residence cards, entry/exit stamps)
Tax office confirmation of no outstanding tax arrears

outcome.duration_length: unlimited (residence card itself valid 10 years, renewed as a card only, not a fresh permit)

gov.pl / Łódzki Urząd Wojewódzki -- Uznanie za obywatela polskiego, reproducing Art. 30 of the Ustawa o obywatelstwie polskim (2 April 2009) in full
Lubuski Urząd Wojewódzki (regional government office, BIP public-information portal) -- Art. 30 tiers, independent cross-check of the Łódzki reproduction

notes: Four distinct OR-logic qualifying groups confirmed directly in the Act on Foreigners' permanent-residence provisions (via mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl and cross-checked against multiple voivodeship-office pages using near-identical statutory language): Karta Polaka holders (0-year wait, fee waived), general economic residents (5-year wait, income/insurance tested), spouses of Polish citizens (3-year marriage + 2-year residence, no income test), and refugee/subsidiary-protection/humanitarian-grounds holders (5-year wait, tied to the protection status specifically rather than residence in general). This is the clearest 4-way OR-group case found anywhere in the Poland build, comparable in shape to the UK Skilled Worker's six qualifying groups documented in the project brief -- the schema absorbed it without structural change, consistent with the brief's core validation claim holding for a 15th country. citizenship_after_months is now precisely resolved per group against Art. 30(1) of the Ustawa o obywatelstwie polskim, cross-confirmed independently across the Łódzki and Lubuski voivodeship offices' gov.pl/BIP pages (which reproduce the statute's numbered subpoints and match each other exactly): 36 months for the general economic track (top-level default, Art. 30(1)(1)), 24 months for the spouse-of-Polish-citizen track (Art. 30(1)(2)(a)) and separately for the refugee/humanitarian track (Art. 30(1)(3)), and 12 months for the Karta Polaka/Polish-origin track (Art. 30(1)(7)) -- previously an unconfirmed single top-level estimate, now four distinct group-level figures each tied to the specific statutory subpoint that produces it, replacing the earlier single-figure placeholder this route shipped with.
